domain: combat gear, ammunition, cosmetic clothing, skilling outfits, cosmetic variants

policy.meaning: Each exact item ID remains an independent item. Group only as an optional semantic set/block; variants, charges, recolours, kits, and similar names do not erase distinctions.
Use explicit reviewed item-ID membership for gear/outfit/cosmetic families. Never propagate membership through name similarity alone.
A missing bonus, equipment slot, wiki category, or page association is unknown, not negative evidence.

Represent independent roles as facets (combat equipable, ammunition/thrown weapon, skilling utility/outfit, cosmetic/reward, transformation/ornament state). Route according to primary player workflow only when supported by explicit evidence and current preset rules.
Zero or absent combat bonuses do not imply cosmetic or junk. Stat-neutral utility gear, defensive pieces, cosmetic variants of functional equipment, and item-specific mechanics remain eligible.

deterministic_detectors.predicate: Local reviewed set catalog contains exact item ID with domain, setKey, and slotRank.
deterministic_detectors.name: exact-set-membership
deterministic_detectors.use: Detect current deterministic family and ordering coverage.

deterministic_detectors.predicate: Exact Wiki item record links the item ID to a named equipment slot or documented equipability.
deterministic_detectors.name: explicit-equipment-fact
deterministic_detectors.use: Positive evidence for equipment role; does not imply combat stats.

deterministic_detectors.predicate: At least one exact-ID combat bonus field is nonzero.
deterministic_detectors.name: positive-combat-bonus
deterministic_detectors.use: Positive combat-gear evidence only; zeros/missing values do not demote.

deterministic_detectors.predicate: Exact-ID Wiki description/category or game mechanic identifies ammo/munition/projectile/thrown weapon; compatible weapon/style may be recorded separately.
deterministic_detectors.name: explicit-ammo-role
deterministic_detectors.use: Ammunition grouping; do not infer from name token alone.

deterministic_detectors.predicate: Wiki set page or exact-ID page documents components and a shared outfit/set effect or reward set.
deterministic_detectors.name: explicit-outfit-set
deterministic_detectors.use: Skilling outfit semantic block, preserving each component.

deterministic_detectors.predicate: Exact-ID source documents cosmetic/recolour/ornament/transmog role, or item is explicitly a cosmetic clothing/reward item.
deterministic_detectors.name: explicit-cosmetic-state
deterministic_detectors.use: Cosmetic grouping with link to base item when documented; cosmetic does not imply nonfunctional.

ambiguity_handling: An item can be a combat item and have a cosmetic variant; retain its combat and cosmetic relationship separately.
A skilling outfit can be wearable and still belong in the skilling workflow rather than combat gear.
Clothing appearance alone is not enough to classify a piece as cosmetic: verify combat or skilling function.
Ornament kits and consumable transformation items are separate inventory identities from their resulting item.
Unavailable/ambiguous source facts remain unverified and are excluded from negative detectors.
source_requirements: Exact item page or authoritative Wiki set page with stable oldid/revision permalink.
For grouped outfit members: component list and effect/source statement, plus exact IDs or unambiguous item-page cross-links.
For ammo compatibility: exact Wiki ammunition and weapon compatibility tables/pages where practical.
Log source page title, oldid, retrieval date, and fields supporting each edge; never cite generic name similarity.
current_gaps: ItemClassificationRefiner uses broad name token logic for some equipment slot and ammo-component classifications; it is a candidate discovery layer and needs exact-ID fact review.
PresetCategoryMapper routes all ItemSetCatalog gear domain members to combat-gear; review explicit set catalog membership and any wearable utility/overlap exceptions.
BankTags routes only subcategories ammo and thrown-weapon to ammunition; verify catalog vocabulary catches every actual munition while preserving usable thrown combat weapons.
Skilling outfit recognition includes a hardcoded subset and legacy TOOL fallback; exact outfit-set catalog coverage should be checked by ID.
ItemSetCatalog is already the appropriate exact-ID mechanism, but families must preserve functional categories and variant identity; no name-based propagation.
dataset: tmp/semantic-audit/joined.jsonl (32,586 effective IDs; 12,576 rows in this domain review universe)
highValueFindings: 32 exact-ID ballista javelins currently use generic GEAR/gear and miss the Ammunition tag; see verified-groups.json.
Seven Wiki-confirmed brutal arrows currently use CLEANUP/cleanup despite positive arrows/ammo evidence.
Barbed bolts ID 881 currently use SKILLING/raw-resources despite positive bolt-ammo evidence.
Documented outfit families lack exact ItemSetCatalog blocks: Angler, Spirit Angler, Farmer, Carpenter, Zealot, Smiths Uniform, Raiments of the Eye, Golden Prospector, four Hunter camouflage sets.
sourceControls: Exact item IDs remain distinct. Optional set edges need explicit source-linked membership.
Positive Category:Ammunition slot items or equipment_slot=ammo alone does not mean projectile ammo; blessings and traversal utilities share that slot.
Missing facts mean unknown. No absence, zero-stat, or similar-name negative inference.
Items storable in the costume room is a storage facet, not proof of cosmetic-only role or a specific destination.
